integrity: The probability and its dimension dependence were derived and checked analytically, using published completion criteria. No independent certification or publication-priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Relies on the published positive-completion characterizations for dimensions two and higher.
Exact nontrivial probability is for square, independent complex Ginibre Wishart matrices only.
An equivalent earlier normalized-Wishart probability calculation may exist under other terminology.
title: Exact Gaussian qubit completion probability and its dimensional collapse
